cues.text: Fuuka puts a pistol to her temple and fires.
Natsuki clutches her head. Junpei stares.
Akihiko, Mitsuru, Junpei, the hero and Yukari brace.
A pale spirit hurls light at a huge armored Shadow.
Its sword and its limp arm lie on the floor.
The hero looks up into the light.
A tall figure rises atop a glass dome, arms spread.
Inside the dome, Fuuka and Natsuki stand together.
